seo.title: Astro Fundamentals: A Five-Part Learning Path
seo.description: A sequenced path through Astro: install and deploy, file-based routing, typed content collections, dynamic routes, and sitemaps. Each part builds on the last.

h1: Astro Fundamentals: A Linear Learning Path
intro: Most Astro tutorials teach features in isolation, which is why so many people can follow one and still cannot build a site. This path is ordered by dependency: each part assumes only what the previous parts covered. Start at part one even if you think you can skip it — the build-time execution model in part one is what makes parts three and four understandable rather than memorized.
